title: Walmart's Marty AI: What Suppliers Can Do With the Updated Assistant
summary: Learn what Walmart's Marty AI can do in Supplier One, including checking purchase orders, managing contacts, creating support tickets, and more.
body_markdown:
In this article, learn about:


-


What Walmart's Marty AI assistant is and how it works within Supplier One


-


How to use Marty to check purchase orders, manage supplier contacts, and create support tickets


-


Where to find additional supplier support resources and what capabilities Walmart plans to introduce next


---


Walmart has expanded Marty AI, the assistant inside[Supplier One](https://www.spscommerce.com/community/articles/what-is-walmarts-supplierone) , so suppliers can look up business-specific information and handle routine tasks without digging through menus. Marty used to answer mostly general questions about Walmart's supplier processes. Now it can check[purchase order (PO)](https://www.spscommerce.com/community/articles/what-is-a-purchase-order) status, find supplier contacts, and create support tickets.


## What Is Walmart's Marty AI?


Marty is Walmart's AI assistant for finding information, navigating workflows, and completing tasks. Suppliers use it in Supplier One, Walmart's centralized system for managing POs, item information, contacts, and support requests. Supplier One runs alongside[Retail Link](https://www.spscommerce.com/community/articles/retail-link-how-does-it-help) , which still provides specialized reporting, analytics, and other supplier applications.


Suppliers ask Marty questions in everyday language, and it answers using information tied to their business. Instead of opening the[PO management app](https://www.spscommerce.com/community/articles/order-management-in-walmarts-supplier-one) to check an order's status, for example, a supplier can ask Marty directly.


## What Can Walmart's Marty AI Do in Supplier One?


### Answer Business-Specific Questions


Ask about your POs, supplier contacts, and support tickets. To find out whether Walmart received a shipment, ask Marty about the PO instead of searching for it yourself. That helps teams juggling many orders or fielding questions from sales, logistics, and customer service.


### Create Support Tickets


Marty can create tickets for domestic and direct import suppliers and route them to the right support team. Describe the problem in plain language instead of picking a support category. For example, explain an error during item setup and ask Marty to open a ticket.


### Look Up and Update Contacts


Marty can find contact details and help you update them, which matters when responsibilities change or people join or leave. You can also ask who your site administrator is or request a full list of contacts.


### Get Workflow Guidance


If you don't use Supplier One daily, tasks like updating contacts or troubleshooting item setup can feel unfamiliar. Marty gives guidance tailored to your business, so you don't have to search through multiple help articles.


**Related Reading:**[Walmart Supplier One Glossary](https://www.spscommerce.com/community/articles/walmart-supplier-one-glossary)


## Who Benefits Most From Marty AI?


Marty is most useful for:


-


Teams managing many POs, who can ask about an order instead of searching for it


-


Sales, logistics, and customer service staff who need quick answers about shipments


-


Occasional Supplier One users, who get guidance on unfamiliar tasks like troubleshooting item setup


-


Suppliers whose teams change, who can look up contacts and update them as people join or leave


-


Domestic and direct import suppliers, who can have Marty create a support ticket and route it to the right team


## How to Use Marty AI in Supplier One


Ask in everyday language. There's no need for special commands or keywords. For the best results, include a PO number, the workflow you're in, or the error you're seeing.


**Supplier task**


**Example prompt**


Check received quantities


"How much of PO #123456 has been received?"


Track a purchase order


"What's the status of PO #123456?"


Find an administrator


"Who is my site administrator contact?"


Review supplier contacts


"Show me all of my supplier contacts."


Report an access issue


"I can't access PO management. Please create a support ticket."


Resolve an item setup issue


"I'm receiving an error when I try to submit my item setup."


Be sure to check business-critical information against your Supplier One records before acting on it.


## Where to Find Walmart Supplier Support Resources


The Supplier Support Hub, accessible from the Supplier One homepage, brings supplier resources into one place:


-


Help documents for common supplier questions and processes


-


Supplier Academy training on Walmart's systems and requirements


-


Support ticket management for submitting and tracking requests


-


Store, Club, and[Distribution Center (DC)](https://www.spscommerce.com/community/articles/walmart-receiving-distribution-center-dc-list) information


-


[Global Location Number (GLN)](https://www.spscommerce.com/community/articles/what-is-a-global-location-number-gln) lists, the location identifiers used in supply chain transactions


The Store/Club/DC and GLN list now lives in the hub, so check there if you can't find it in its old location.


## What If Marty Can't Answer a Question?


Marty won't be able to resolve every issue that pops up. You can still create and manage support tickets manually: select the question mark icon in the upper-right corner of Supplier One, then go to Help > Manage Tickets.


For complex issues involving retailer compliance, transaction errors, or disputed information, keep using the appropriate support and resolution processes.


Walmart has indicated it plans to add business-specific questions about:


-


[Claims](https://www.spscommerce.com/community/articles/the-difference-between-retailer-deductions-and-allowances) associated with your business


-


Item information for your business


-


[Electronic data interchange (EDI)](https://www.spscommerce.com/community/articles/what-is-edi-electronic-data-interchange) invoice information


Walmart hasn't yet announced release dates, so watch Supplier One announcements for updates.


## Get Started With Marty AI


Start with a simple question about an existing PO or supplier contact. For more on Walmart supplier operations, EDI, retailer compliance, and supply chain management, explore The Supply Chain Source.
